reviews.title: Crashes and freezes
reviews.text: I’m disappointed to report that since deciding to PAY for this app, it does nothing but freeze and crash. I’ll start a run on my phone, but then look down to discover it’s keeping track of time but not distance. I try to pause and restart only to discover the screen is frozen. Quitting and restarting the app does not help. Just finished my most recent run 20 mins ago and still can’t get the app to load. Super bummed out as I was excited to use their training programs to prepare for some races in my near future but it doesn’t seem possible! Hoping this is an issue that others are experiencing so they fix this problem. Willing to re-write my review if things change or improve!

reviews.title: Advert Notifications
reviews.text: I do not need a run tracker bad enough to have a notification nonstop that’s not even about me or my running. It’s triggering and intrusive. I have visceral reactions to being propositioned non stop on behalf of net profits. When will it be enough.

reviews.title: Where is support????
reviews.text: I have continued to have issues with the app since September 28 after starting a new plan. I reached out to support. Four days later I heard from someone about an update which I had already completed. I heard back the following day asking if it worked. No it did not was my response. Another three days pass and asked if I was still having issues. I said yes the same issues persisted. So here I am four days later (week 2 from reporting issues) and have yet to hear back at all. So disappointed!

reviews.title: Removed Apple Watch Support
reviews.text: I’ve been using Runkeeper for 10+ years. I was really disappointed when I went on my latest run to see that the app is no longer supported on my older Apple Watch. A warning that this was coming would have been really nice.

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text: Disappointed did not read my pace and miles only time

reviews.title: Not keeping correct intervals
reviews.text: I have had this app for almost 10 years and it is a favorite of mine. Lately though, it has not been keeping track of my intervals , it keep saying the pace is 0:00/mile and it’s tough to keep track during a run while training for a race. Pretty disappointing

reviews.title: Can’t connect to Coros
reviews.text: There are instructions but the option is not inside the app to choose coros, perhaps they are outdated. Tracking with my phone obliterates my battery.

reviews.title: Let down by poor Apple Watch integration
reviews.text: I’m a subscriber and appreciate a lot about this app, but find its integration with an Apple Watch is a bit of an afterthought. Frequently I’ll start a run on the phone and discover that a workout was not then started on the watch and I then get no heart rate tracking. Other apps I use manage this very well - hevy for example has no issue getting heart rates when I start a workout on my phone, and comes to the foreground on the watch without me needing to do anything.

reviews.title: Too many popups
reviews.text: Too many popups in this ad. I don’t want to access your communities. I don’t want to take part in your dumb challenges. Quit popping up every time I complete a run. Ffs leave me alone

reviews.title: what the hell
reviews.text: the app controls are gone. i had used thus for many years and all of a sudden all there is  is a time and distance monitor that won't let me change anything. time to delete

reviews.title: Was a great app until recently
reviews.text: I use this app for over a decade, considered it absolutely phenomenal. However recently, the app started having some sort of issue where I couldn’t close it. So I deleted it and tried to reinstall it, and if since lost all of my account information workouts. And it seems that there’s no way to recover it.

reviews.title: Was great now not good
reviews.text: It was great in the beginning never had any problems, but now it won’t track. My heart rate won’t sync with my Apple Watch and won’t sync it the other apps that usually goes been having this problem for a couple weeks now.

reviews.title: Latest Update Broken App
reviews.text:
I’ve used Runkeeper for 13 years. Latest update has broken indoor runs as it no longer records heartbeat, no longer syncs to Apple Watch, no longer records workout to Apple Health. 
Logged issue weeks ago but no fix. 
Essentially useless for indoor runs now.

reviews.title: Paywalling previously-free features is bad business.
reviews.text: Runkeeper used to show how each run stacked up with your previous outings, and then they one day decided to renege on that and put it behind a paywall. I think this is a lousy business practice, and deserves to be called out.

reviews.title: IT support? lol, no
reviews.text:
I’ve been a Runkeeper customer for 10 years. Recently, upon trying to log back in, I received a JavaScript error “undefined is not an object.” I use the feedback button to contact the app developer, which promised they would reach out to me “right away.” over the course of multiple messages, I received one reply, suggesting I clear the cache, delete and reinstall. I did this multiple times, even changed the browser, and still receive the same error message. I’ve now informed them multiple times that their “fix” didn’t work - no help. I am still able to log onto the desktop version, so this is an app issue. Support from the developer has been really disappointing.
Update: now nearing two weeks that I’ve been unable to use the app.

reviews.title: Got worse with time
reviews.text: So many features don’t work or bug out and they have the audacity to ask for £40 membership that’s insane.

reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: Stopped tracking runs. Kept forgetting I had the ‘Go’ version and now doesn’t log in at all. Unusable now. Such a shame.

reviews.title: Update Issues
reviews.text: is it a glitch or have maps of my run been removed? Also, my run distance isn’t being recorded I have to enter it manually, is that a glitch as well?

reviews.title: No longer logging activities
reviews.text: Since the update a couple of days ago, the app no longer updates with activities from my Garmin watch. It used to be that after a run the app would update with details from the watch automatically, but now it doesn’t.

reviews.title: Can’t track route
reviews.text: You used to be able to track route on this app but you can’t unless you pay.  App is nowhere near as good as it used to be

reviews.title: Paywalled
reviews.text: Having used Runkeeper for over 10 years, they have now Paywalled basic information - such as comparing historical runs - behind a £12 a month Paywall. Request your data and import it to Strava.

reviews.title: Become buggy and unreliable
reviews.text:
I’ve been using for a while now but past few months it’s been unreliable in recording accurate data from my watch. I also get sun issues when trying to save runs from my watch to my iPhone. Really annoying.

I love asics and wear them for running but if this isn’t fixed I’ll have to use another app.

reviews.title: Deleted all data with no warning.
reviews.text:
Seems they decided to delete a number of inactive accounts without any warning. 
No message.. no nothing. 
Whole account removed with all runs and history erased.
Delightful. 
No reason to come back now. See ya.

reviews.title: Lost my data
reviews.text: I have used this app for around 7 years and found it useful because it captures ongoing performance. However recently it has lost my data before 2025 and the customer service department doesn’t respond to any questions about it. Not great and I now have to find another app despite paying for the premium option.
